_note: Prices, notes and ABV taken from shop.reddotbrewhouse.com.sg (Oct 2026). Photos downloaded from their shop and resized to 800px in src/assets/products/.

products.name: Monster Green Lager
products.notes: Spirulina-infused lager that pours sparkling green. Citrus and malt on the nose, with a clean, crisp, malty finish and a champagne-like fizz.

products.name: Yuzu Craze Pilsner
products.notes: A burst of yuzu in an easy-drinking pilsner. Fruity on the palate with a crisp finish. A must for any citrus lover.

products.name: Czech Pilsner
products.notes: A lager brewed in classic style, fragrant with hints of citrus hops and a clean, crisp finish. A true thirst-quencher.

products.name: Lemon Sour Hard Seltzer
products.notes: An alcoholic lemonade inspired by the brewing family's love of Japanese izakaya. Refreshing, citrusy, sweet yet sour. Best served on ice.

products.name: India Pale Ale
products.notes: Brewed in the spirit of the beer once shipped to British troops in India. Spiced with potent hops, tempered by malt, with a long, smooth finish.

products.name: Dream Stout
products.notes: Rich, chocolatey and roasty, with a smooth finish.

products.name: Chrysanthemum Rum Lager
products.notes: Built by deconstructing white chrysanthemum and rum into a lager. Made to take a Chinese dinner to the next level.

products.name: Summer Ale
products.notes: Malty, mildly hoppy and perfectly balanced. A golden ale with a floral nose that suits any occasion.

products.name: Heartlander Ale
products.notes: An easy-drinking session ale made to take on the equatorial sun. Our brewer's reminder to keep dreaming, even when the going gets rough.

products.name: Weizen
products.notes: Big and bold, with clove, banana and orange on the nose and palate. A cloudy wheat beer that's refreshing and smooth.

products.name: Hidden Hills Cempaka Gin
products.notes: From our Hidden Hills distillery. Cempaka flowers are harvested at night, when their fragrance peaks, and distilled straight away, from branch to bottle.

products.name: Hidden Hills Single Malt Whisky
products.notes: Distilled and bottled on site, then finished in PX sherry casks. Layers of dried fruit, dark chocolate and warm spice, with a long, refined sweetness.

products.name: Hidden Hills Cask-Strength Whisky
products.notes: An uncompromising expression, distilled and bottled entirely on site. Presented at cask strength for real depth, power and complexity.

products.name: Island Spirits Yuzu Whiskey
products.notes: Aged five years in American oak in Singapore, then infused with fresh yuzu. Have it as a highball with soda, neat, or as an easy whiskey sour.

products.name: Island Spirits Bayberry Whisky Sour
products.notes: Smooth whisky blended with sweet, rich bayberries. Velvety and fruity. Enjoy it straight or over ice.

products.name: 30L Party Keg
products.notes: Fresh RedDot craft beer by the keg, for parties and events. Price includes a S$350 refundable deposit.

products.name: S$50 RedDot Gift Voucher
products.notes: A gift for any occasion. Valid for six months from the date of purchase.

products.name: Beer Shampoo
products.notes: Made with our own craft beer and plant-derived cleansers. A clean, Singapore-made formula that leaves hair refreshed.
